verdict.rationale: There is no documented in-product AI feature that generates insights or suggestions from your data. The dashboards show raw analytics such as spend, sessions, tool calls and risk findings, and the in-dashboard agent harness is only for testing MCP servers. The closest AI-native route runs outside the product: the platform MCP server lets an admin's own agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) read observability data and reason over it. Missing for 10: native in-dashboard AI-generated insights or recommendations over usage, cost and risk data; documented suggestion features; independent or hands-on corroboration.
